SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS name, c.phone AS phone, CASE WHEN c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 THEN '신규' WHEN c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12) THEN '휴면' ELSE '일반' END AS customerType, TO_CHAR(c.joined_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS joinedAt, TO_CHAR( (SELECT MAX(sh.completed_at) FROM send_target st JOIN send_history sh ON st.send_history_id = sh.id WHERE st.customer_id = c.id AND st.is_deleted = 0 AND sh.is_deleted = 0), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI' ) AS lastSend, NVL(ccc.sms_consent, 0) AS smsConsent, NVL(ccc.kakao_consent, 0) AS kakaoConsent, NVL(ccc.rcs_consent, 0) AS rcsConsent, NVL(ccc.email_consent, 0) AS emailConsent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sub_ccc.customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'SMS' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS sms_consent, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'KAKAO_ALIM' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS kakao_consent, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'RCS' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS rcs_consent, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'EMAIL' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS email_consent FROM customer_channel_consent sub_ccc JOIN channel sub_ch ON sub_ccc.channel_id = sub_ch.id WHERE sub_ccc.is_deleted = 0 AND sub_ch.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sub_ccc.customer_id ) ccc ON c.id = ccc.customer_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
AND c.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM reject_history WHERE is_deleted = 0)
AND c.name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND c.phone LIKE '%' || #{phone} || '%'
AND c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7
AND c.joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12)
AND c.joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND (c.last_active_at IS NULL OR c.last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12))
AND c.id IN ( SELECT ctm.customer_id FROM customer_tag_mapping ctm JOIN tag t ON ctm.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.name = #{searchTag} AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 )
ORDER BY
c.name ASC
(CASE WHEN c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 THEN '1' WHEN c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12) THEN '3' ELSE '2' END) ASC, c.name ASC
c.joined_at DESC, c.id DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sub_ccc.customer_id, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'SMS' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS sms_consent, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'KAKAO_ALIM' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS kakao_consent, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'RCS' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS rcs_consent, MAX(CASE WHEN sub_ch.channel_type = 'EMAIL' THEN sub_ccc.is_consented ELSE 0 END) AS email_consent FROM customer_channel_consent sub_ccc JOIN channel sub_ch ON sub_ccc.channel_id = sub_ch.id WHERE sub_ccc.is_deleted = 0 AND sub_ch.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY sub_ccc.customer_id ) ccc ON c.id = ccc.customer_id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
AND c.id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM reject_history WHERE is_deleted = 0)
AND c.name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND c.phone LIKE '%' || #{phone} || '%'
AND c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7
AND c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12)
AND c.joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND (c.last_active_at IS NULL OR c.last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12))
AND c.id IN ( SELECT ctm.customer_id FROM customer_tag_mapping ctm JOIN tag t ON ctm.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.name = #{searchTag} AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 )

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN is_deleted = 0 THEN 1 END) AS totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_deleted = 0 AND joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND (last_active_at IS NULL OR last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12)) THEN 1 END) AS regularCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_deleted = 0 AND joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 THEN 1 END) AS newCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_deleted = 0 AND joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12) THEN 1 END) AS dormantCount FROM customer
SELECT t.name FROM customer_tag_mapping ctm JOIN tag t ON ctm.tag_id = t.id WHERE ctm.customer_id = #{customerId} AND ctm.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.name ASC

SELECT st.id AS sendHistoryId, TO_CHAR(sh.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS sentAt, sh.title AS templateName, ch.channel_type AS channel, st.status AS status, (SELECT fr.description FROM send_attempt sa JOIN fail_reason fr ON sa.id = fr.send_attempt_id WHERE sa.send_target_id = st.id AND sa.is_succeeded = 0 AND ROWNUM = 1) AS failReason FROM send_target st JOIN send_history sh ON st.send_history_id = sh.id AND sh.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN channel ch ON st.final_channel_id = ch.id AND ch.is_deleted = 0 WHERE st.customer_id = #{customerId} AND st.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sh.created_at DESC

SELECT c.id AS customerId, c.name AS name, c.phone AS phone, TO_CHAR(rh.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS rejectedAt FROM reject_history rh
JOIN customer c ON rh.customer_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE rh.is_deleted = 0
AND c.name LIKE '%' || #{name} || '%'
AND c.phone LIKE '%' || #{phone} || '%'
AND c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7
AND c.joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12)
AND c.joined_at < SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 AND (c.last_active_at IS NULL OR c.last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12))
ORDER BY
c.name ASC
(CASE WHEN c.joined_at >= SYSTIMESTAMP - 7 THEN '1' WHEN c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(SYSTIMESTAMP, -12) THEN '3' ELSE '2' END) ASC, c.name ASC
rh.created_at DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
